name: TypeScript
description: TypeScript adds a static type system to JavaScript, helping you catch mistakes earlier and design better APIs. This track covers core types and a small project pattern.

snippets.title: Initialize a TypeScript Project
snippets.codeDes: Create a project and install TypeScript compiler tooling.
snippets.code:
mkdir ts-lab
cd ts-lab
npm init -y
npm install -D typescript tsx @types/node
npx tsc --init

snippets.title: Recommended tsconfig for Learning
snippets.codeDes: Enable strict mode early so type feedback is useful from day one.

snippets.title: Model Domain Data with Types and Interfaces
snippets.codeDes: Use aliases for unions and interfaces for object shapes.

snippets.title: Generic Helper for API Results
snippets.codeDes: Generics let one utility function stay type-safe for many response shapes.

snippets.title: Discriminated Union for Command Parsing
snippets.codeDes: Use command tags to safely branch business logic.

snippets.title: Type Guard for Unknown JSON
snippets.codeDes: Validate unknown values from files or APIs before trusting their shape.

snippets.title: Mini Project: Expense Store with Typed Reducer
snippets.codeDes: Small project idea: build a typed expense tracker core you can reuse in React, Node, or tests.

snippets.title: Typed Fetch Function
snippets.codeDes: Create one reusable fetch wrapper with a typed return value.

snippets.title: Run Type Checks and Execute Files
snippets.codeDes: Use tsc for static checks and tsx for fast local execution.
snippets.code:
npx tsc --noEmit
npx tsx src/index.ts
npx tsc

snippets.title: Next Learning Upgrades
snippets.codeDes: Move from language fundamentals to architecture-level usage.
snippets.code:
1. Add zod schemas and infer TS types from them.
2. Add utility types for API response normalization.
3. Add strict lint rules for unsafe any usage.
4. Add contract tests for typed clients.
5. Add monorepo packages with shared TypeScript types.
